content.value_statement: Academic research tasks often require careful reading, synthesis, and citation discipline. This skill helps structure paper reviews, literature summaries, and scholarly writing with consistent academic standards.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes papers by research question, methodology, findings, significance, limitations, and future directions.
Structures literature reviews around themes, theories, evidence, research gaps, and conclusions.
Formats citation examples for APA, MLA, and Chicago styles.
Evaluates methods, samples, variables, measures, and analytical choices in research papers.
Supports formal academic writing standards, including evidence-based claims and clear argument structure.
limitations: It does not retrieve paywalled articles or guarantee access to external databases.
It cannot verify citation accuracy unless source details are provided.
It is not a substitute for peer review, supervisor feedback, or subject expert judgment.
Its analysis quality depends on the papers, excerpts, or research notes supplied by the user.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Literature Review
use_cases.description: Organize sources into themes, compare findings, and identify gaps for a thesis or manuscript.

use_cases.title: Screen Research Papers
use_cases.description: Extract research questions, methods, findings, and limitations before deciding which papers need deeper review.

use_cases.title: Improve Scholarly Drafts
use_cases.description: Check whether claims are supported, arguments flow logically, and academic tone remains precise.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Paper
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this paper using citation, research question, methodology, key findings, significance, limitations, and future directions: [paste paper text].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these sources by research question, methods, findings, limitations, and how each source relates to the others: [paste notes].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Literature Review Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a literature review outline for this topic. Group sources by theme, identify debates, and list research gaps: [topic and sources].

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Methodological Strength
prompt_templates.prompt: Critique the methodology in this study. Address design, sample, measures, analysis, validity threats, limitations, and stronger alternatives: [paste method section].

output_examples.input: Summarize a study about spaced repetition and long-term learning.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the research question, describes the study design, lists key findings, explains significance, notes limitations, and suggests future research.

output_examples.input: Create a literature review structure for adaptive learning systems.
output_examples.output: The response groups sources by themes such as learner modeling, feedback timing, evaluation methods, research gaps, and practical implications.

output_examples.input: Review my draft paragraph for academic tone and evidence use.
output_examples.output: The response flags unsupported claims, suggests more precise wording, improves transitions, and separates evidence from interpretation.

best_practices: Provide full paper text, abstracts, or detailed notes when requesting summaries or critiques.
Ask for citation style requirements before generating references or bibliography sections.
Separate source evidence from your own interpretation when drafting academic arguments.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent citations, page numbers, study results, or author claims.
Do not rely on generated summaries without checking the original paper.
Do not use it as the only reviewer for high-stakes academic submissions.

faq.question: Can this skill write a full literature review?
faq.answer: It can help outline, synthesize, and draft sections, but the user must verify sources and arguments.

faq.question: Does it search academic databases?
faq.answer: The skill itself provides research workflows and writing guidance. Database access depends on the host tool and user-provided sources.

faq.question: Which citation styles does it support?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for APA, MLA, and Chicago examples, and can adapt when the user provides style requirements.

faq.question: Can it evaluate research methods?
faq.answer: Yes. It prompts review of design, sample, variables, measures, analysis, limitations, and validity concerns.

faq.question: Is it suitable for non-scientific disciplines?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides general scholarly review structure and can adapt to humanities, social science, and technical domains.

faq.question: Can it guarantee citation accuracy?
faq.answer: No. Users should verify every citation against the original source or an authoritative database.
